entities.summary: Linux Format was the UK's first Linux-specific magazine, and as of 2013 was the best-selling Linux title in the UK. It was also exported to many countries worldwide. It was published by Future plc. Linux Format was commonly abbreviated to LXF, and issues are referred to with LXF as a prefix followed by the issue number.
